# Annamalai Vikash Raam Manoj

I'm currently studying **Business Analytics at Monash University**, building on a Computer Science degree specialising in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning.

## Where technology meets business

My interest in analytics lies in moving from a question to an evidence-based answer. I enjoy exploring datasets, identifying patterns, and using visualisations to make findings easier to understand.

My experience and interests span:

- **Data analysis and visualisation** — exploring data and communicating findings clearly.
- **Databases and analytics** — working with structured data to answer practical questions.
- **Applied AI** — understanding how technical methods can contribute to real-world solutions.

## Beyond the coursework

This website is a place to document selected projects, share analytical stories, and explore ideas as I develop my skills.
